class.name: InputMapSettingsEvent
class.brief_description: One event as stored in the file of [InputMapSettingsServer].
class.description: The file form of one bindable [InputEvent] (key, mouse button, gamepad button or gamepad axis) in the settings file of [InputMapSettingsServer]: named fields instead of a sub-resource, the same in JSON, INI, YAML, TOML and XML. [InputMapSettingsServer] converts between [InputEvent] and this record when it saves and loads; games do not need this class, but [method to_text] and [method from_text] give the text form [code][Device<N>:]<Type>:[<Modifiers>+]<Input>[/code] of an event (see [method InputAction.event_to_text]). Examples: [code]Keyboard:W[/code], [code]Keyboard:Ctrl+Shift+S[/code], [code]Keyboard:CmdOrCtrl+Z[/code], [code]Keyboard:Colon[/code], [code]Keyboard:Shift+Semicolon[/code], [code]Keyboard:Ctrl+Plus[/code], [code]Keyboard:Shift[/code], [code]KeyboardLabel:W[/code], [code]Mouse:Ctrl+Left[/code], [code]Gamepad:LeftShoulder[/code], [code]GamepadAxis:LeftStickLeft[/code], [code]Device3:Gamepad:A[/code], [code]Device3:GamepadAxis:RightTrigger[/code]. The fields hold the same values: [code]Keyboard:Ctrl+Shift+S[/code] is [member device] [code]Keyboard[/code], [member modifiers] [code]Ctrl+Shift[/code], [member input] [code]S[/code]; [code]Device3:GamepadAxis:LeftStickLeft[/code] is [member device] [code]Gamepad[/code], [member input] [code]LeftStickLeft[/code], [member device_id] [code]3[/code].

method.name: from_event
method.description: Returns the record of [param event], or [code]null[/code] for event types that have none (touch, MIDI, ...). A key with a physical keycode is written with [constant KEY_MODE_PHYSICAL], a key with a keycode with [constant KEY_MODE_LABEL], a key with only a key label with [constant KEY_MODE_PRINTED]. The [member device_id] is the number of the pad for a gamepad event of one pad, otherwise [code]Any[/code].

method.name: from_text
method.description: Returns the record of a text form [code][Device<N>:]<Type>:[<Modifiers>+]<Input>[/code] such as [code]Keyboard:Ctrl+S[/code], [code]KeyboardLabel:E[/code], [code]Mouse:Left[/code], [code]Gamepad:A[/code] or [code]Device1:GamepadAxis:LeftStickLeft[/code], or [code]null[/code] if the text is not valid. Everything [method InputAction.text_to_event] reads is read: [code]Any:[/code], the [code]@N[/code] suffix and the older names ([code]Key:[/code], [code]PhysicalKey:[/code], [code]KeyLabel:[/code], [code]MouseButton:[/code], [code]JoypadButton:[/code], [code]JoypadMotion:[/code], [code]LeftX-[/code], [code]TriggerRight+[/code], [code]LeftStick[/code]).

method.name: to_event
method.description: Returns a new event of this record, or [code]null[/code] if it is not valid (no [member input], an unknown name, [member modifiers] on a gamepad). The event reacts to all devices ([member InputEvent.device] [code]-1[/code]), a gamepad event with a number in [member device_id] only to that pad. A gamepad [member input] is a button name or an axis name ([code]LeftStickLeft[/code]); the older axis form with a sign ([code]LeftX-[/code]) is read, too.

method.name: to_text
method.description: Returns the text form [code][Device<N>:]<Type>:[<Modifiers>+]<Input>[/code] of this record, as [method InputAction.event_to_text] writes it: [code]Keyboard:Ctrl+S[/code], [code]KeyboardLabel:E[/code], [code]Mouse:Left[/code], [code]Gamepad:A[/code], [code]GamepadAxis:LeftStickLeft[/code], [code]Device1:Gamepad:A[/code] (the prefix only for one pad).

members.member: The kind of event: [constant DEVICE_KEYBOARD], [constant DEVICE_MOUSE] or [constant DEVICE_GAMEPAD]. Written as [code]Keyboard[/code], [code]Mouse[/code] or [code]Gamepad[/code].
The pad of a gamepad event: [code]Any[/code] (all pads) or the number of one pad.

The key, button or axis: a key name of [method OS.get_keycode_string] such as [code]W[/code], [code]Space[/code], [code]Colon[/code] or [code]Plus[/code] (never a character), a mouse button ([code]Left[/code], [code]WheelUp[/code], ...), a gamepad button ([code]A[/code], [code]LeftShoulder[/code], [code]LeftStickPress[/code], ...) or a gamepad axis with its direction ([code]LeftStickLeft[/code], [code]LeftStickUp[/code], [code]RightTrigger[/code], ...). The names are those of [method InputAction.text_to_event].

How a key is matched: [constant KEY_MODE_PHYSICAL] (the key position, [member InputEventKey.physical_keycode], text type [code]Keyboard[/code]), [constant KEY_MODE_LABEL] (the key with this label on the current layout, [member InputEventKey.keycode], [code]KeyboardLabel[/code]) or [constant KEY_MODE_PRINTED] ([member InputEventKey.key_label], [code]KeyboardPrinted[/code]). Only for [constant DEVICE_KEYBOARD].

The modifiers, joined by [code]+[/code], for example [code]Ctrl+Shift[/code]. The names are [code]CmdOrCtrl[/code], [code]Ctrl[/code], [code]Alt[/code], [code]Shift[/code] and [code]Meta[/code]. Only for keyboard and mouse events.

constants.constant: The key at a position of the keyboard, whatever the layout.
The key with a label on the current layout.
The key that prints this character ([member InputEventKey.key_label]).
